declared_intent: Coordinate bounded multi-agent work with file ownership, concurrency caps, and approval thresholds.

allowed_by_default: Plan parallel subtasks inside the current workspace.
Spawn or coordinate agents only when the host supports it and the user asks for it.
Write reports or patches in assigned file scopes.
confirmation_required: Any task that touches credentials, production, or external accounts.
denied_by_default: Agents modifying overlapping files without coordination.
Background work beyond the user-approved scope.

token_optimization: Move orchestration templates and role matrices into config/references.
selection_precision: Rank for explicit multi-agent delegation, not ordinary task planning.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
